units.source_text: 这样，我看见了她在我的眼前把和服的腰带解开了，把许多细带解开了，带子发出悉索声解开了。

en.t: In this way, I saw her untie the sash of her kimono before my eyes, then untie the many narrow cords, which came loose with a soft rustling sound.
The opening of her collar loosened.

units.source_text: 她的手插进隐约可见的白皙的胸脯，然后把左边的乳房掏了出来，裸露在我的面前。

en.t: Her hand slipped into the faintly visible whiteness of her breast, then drew out her left breast and bared it before me.
